title: Lobed Mirror with Heaven and Earth between the Paired Phoenixes
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
Circle above and square below:
These are symbols of heaven and earth.
In the middle are the Eight Trigrams,
Making clear [the forces of] yin and yang.
Stars and constellations are well aligned;
The sun and the moon are virtuous and bright.
Circulating around [the earth] is water,
Giving identity to the Four Great Rivers.
Within are the mountain ranges,
To signify the lordly heights.
passages.source_text:
上圓下方，象于天地。
中列八填，備著陰陽。
辰星鎮定，日月貞明。
周流為水，以名四瀆。
內置連山，以旌王岳。

note: Complete museum-published inscription rendering; AncientLens scholarly review remains unreviewed. The museum describes the outer inscription and repeats its full ten-line English rendering; the same transcription and translation are supplied here.
